purpose: Issue #4414: add two read-only PC-CROP showroom entry paths over the same synthetic presentation data: a privileged PLATFORM_OWNER+MFA staff entry and a short-lived high-entropy presentation bearer entry. Neither path impersonates business users, weakens production RBAC, enables public demo credentials, fetches real customer data or permits production mutations.
requiredInvariants: The privileged showroom requires a server-verified PLATFORM_OWNER session with MFA.
The temporary presentation entry accepts only a high-entropy bearer whose plaintext is absent from source, whose SHA-256 digest is compared in constant time and whose validity has a fixed expiry.
The temporary bearer grants access only to synthetic read-only showroom rendering and is not accepted by business APIs, auth APIs or staff APIs.
Neither showroom path mints or impersonates a business-user session.
Normal platform-v7 role, user, membership, organization and tenant equality checks remain unchanged.
No passwordless demo route, universal password, role-test credential or canonical test seed is enabled in production.
The owner access token is used only for staff authority verification and is never sent to business-data endpoints from the showroom.
All displayed organizations, role facts, deal facts and amounts are synthetic presentation data.
All operations that could mutate a deal, payment, document, lab result, arbitration state or external integration are disabled in showroom rendering.
The employee organization-profile surface is included alongside the twelve existing execution-role surfaces.
Every showroom screen is visibly marked TEST or SHOWROOM and robots indexing is disabled.
No database, migration, production environment, external integration or recurring-cost change is included.
acceptance: Focused unit source contract proves PLATFORM_OWNER plus MFA gating for the privileged entry.
Focused unit source contract proves SHA-256 constant-time bearer verification, finite expiry and absence of plaintext bearer from source.
Focused unit source contract proves exactly the thirteen requested showroom surfaces are represented in both entry modes.
Focused unit source contract proves no business proxy/deals/logistics/lab workspace fetch is present.
Focused unit source contract proves mutating cockpit actions are disabled and SHOWROOM labeling is present.
Exact-head web unit, Node CI, security and governance checks pass before merge.
Production acceptance opens all thirteen showroom surfaces using the temporary presentation link and separately confirms owner entry when owner credentials are available.
